purpose: Keep local/cloud intelligence replaceable while canonical state, authority and evidence remain outside provider runtimes.
attention_rule: Does not occupy CURRENT unless it unlocks an active conversion or a material security/compatibility event requires action.

decision.law: Model decision never equals execution authority.

hermes.known_stable_tag: 0.21.3 reference; newer tags require isolated conversion-relevant proof before promotion

grok_build.law: Benchmark model x harness as one executor.

remote_renderer.law: Remote rendering never becomes source or lineage authority.

reopen_when: A material security/compatibility change affects an installed provider.
An active conversion needs a decision/media/agent capability.
Canonical state is becoming trapped inside framework memory.
A real local-vs-cloud or executor decision needs measured evidence.
A provider can materially simplify a current head without creating a new control surface.
stop_condition: If no current conversion is unlocked and no material node decision is pending, park this substrate after recording the durable delta.

executor_identity.law: A release label is not executable identity. Proof receipts bind the tested model x harness to the actual runtime/backend and artifact bytes where applicable.
executor_identity.transition_law: Provider/backend transitions are explicit receipt events; security, invalid-request and authority-denied failures STOP and never trigger silent hopping.

watch_state.purpose: Persist reconnaissance baselines so future scouts report material deltas instead of rediscovering unchanged ecosystem state.
watch_state.admission: A finding enters CURRENT only when it unlocks an active conversion or materially changes security, compatibility, deployment, pinning, rollback, authority, or local-vs-cloud placement.
watch_state.suppression: Routine releases, cosmetic changes and ordinary dependency churn remain silent.
watch_state.proof_rule: A new release/tag is evidence to inspect, never promotion authority.
